explication: Dockge is a self-hosted, file-based Docker Compose stack manager. Users browse or edit stacks, perform Compose lifecycle actions, and follow live progress or terminal output; administrators also configure access and connect remote agents. The map preserves the documented image-update, command-to-Compose, and multi-agent capabilities, though their specific implementation paths are not established by the excerpts. Several frontend-to-server relationships are therefore shown as unverified rather than inferred from module names.
